note: Only rules with a verified source are listed. Soil-moisture and temperature cut-offs are NOT included until each has a source (Sprint 1). Lower priority number = handled first.

rules.message: Flowering is the stage most sensitive to water shortage and no rain was reported this week. A sourced soil-moisture cut-off is not yet available, so please ask your extension officer to assess the field.
rules.source: FAO crop information: Maize (flowering most sensitive to water deficit); cut-off pending

rules.message: Possible fall armyworm feeding. Check 10 consecutive plants at each of 10 random spots in the field. If about 20% of plants have larvae, contact your extension officer or agro-input dealer for control advice.
rules.source: IITA Guide for sustainable maize production in Ghana (2025), p. 27

rules.message: The reported sign can have several causes and no supported rule covers it yet. Please ask your extension officer to look at the crop.
rules.source: IITA Guide (2025), pp. 22, 27: consult extension officers

rules.message: No concern matched the reported observations. Keep monitoring the crop and report again if conditions or symptoms change.
